## Description

What sinks in the bog does not always come back up as what it was.

## Notes

The same adversary in English, written the same way — the frontmatter
with the note's own spellings, the description as a `## Description`
section — with the captions from the `en` table. The deck prints `de`
and leaves it out. This section is a property nobody binds and stays
off the card.
